question.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

exchange.sent: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

answer.answer:
| Automotive radar change | VNA measurement capability affected | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| RF bands include 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz automotive radar frontends | VNA frequency coverage must extend from microwave into mmWave; 76 GHz to 81 GHz is above a 67 GHz base VNA’s 10 MHz to 67 GHz range and within a 10 MHz to 110 GHz VNA system range | [40][8][17] |
| R&S AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD frontends operate at 76.0 GHz to 81.0 GHz with 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 5 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth | VNA characterization must handle automotive radar frontends with multi-GHz operating bandwidth, not only narrowband S-parameter checks | [49] |
| RF transfer characteristics for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D are measured from RX waveguide input to TX waveguide output connector with a VNA setup using 2.5 MHz frequency step size and 1 kHz measurement bandwidth | VNA measurement setup must support fine frequency stepping and controlled IF/measurement bandwidth for radar frontend transfer characterization | [45] |
| Amplitude flatness is specified as < ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D configurations | VNA capability must support amplitude-flatness measurement across GHz-wide radar bandwidths | [45] |
| Group delay flatness is specified as < ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±1 ns in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±1 ns in 4 GHz bandwidth for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D configurations | VNA capability must support group-delay flatness measurement across GHz-wide radar bandwidths | [45] |
| Suppression of ghost objects is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain, using 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m distance to wanted artificial object, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz | VNA capability must include time-domain analysis and sufficiently fine frequency resolution/span settings for ghost-object evaluation | [14] |
| AREG800A IF transfer measurements use VNA conditions of 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz | VNA capability must cover multi-GHz IF transfer spans with controlled source power and measurement bandwidth | [15] |
| R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option | A VNA used for these measurements has configurable measurement bandwidth, but the cited automotive radar transfer measurements specifically use 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth rather than requiring the full 30 MHz option | [34][14][15] |
| R&S ZNA supports time domain analysis as a software/measurement option, and time-domain VNA measurement is used for suppression of ghost objects | Time-domain capability is relevant to automotive radar echo/ghost-object measurement | [29][14] |
【推論】As automotive radar shifts toward 76 GHz to 81 GHz and multi-GHz bandwidths, the VNA requirement moves from lower-frequency coverage toward a 110 GHz-class mmWave VNA system plus GHz-span amplitude, group-delay, and time-domain measurement capability [40][49][17][45][14].

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

|---|---|---|
| RF bands include 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz automotive radar frontends | VNA frequency coverage must extend from microwave into mmWave; 76 GHz to 81 GHz is above a 67 GHz base VNA’s 10 MHz to 67 GHz range and within a 10 MHz to 110 GHz VNA system range | [40][8][17] |
| R&S AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD frontends operate at 76.0 GHz to 81.0 GHz with 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 5 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth | VNA characterization must handle automotive radar frontends with multi-GHz operating bandwidth, not only narrowband S-parameter checks | [49] |
| RF transfer characteristics for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D are measured from RX waveguide input to TX waveguide output connector with a VNA setup using 2.5 MHz frequency step size and 1 kHz measurement bandwidth | VNA measurement setup must support fine frequency stepping and controlled IF/measurement bandwidth for radar frontend transfer characterization | [45] |
| Amplitude flatness is specified as < ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D configurations | VNA capability must support amplitude-flatness measurement across GHz-wide radar bandwidths | [45] |
| Group delay flatness is specified as < ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±1 ns in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±1 ns in 4 GHz bandwidth for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D configurations | VNA capability must support group-delay flatness measurement across GHz-wide radar bandwidths | [45] |
| Suppression of ghost objects is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain, using 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m distance to wanted artificial object, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz | VNA capability must include time-domain analysis and sufficiently fine frequency resolution/span settings for ghost-object evaluation | [14] |
| AREG800A IF transfer measurements use VNA conditions of 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz | VNA capability must cover multi-GHz IF transfer spans with controlled source power and measurement bandwidth | [15] |
| R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option | A VNA used for these measurements has configurable measurement bandwidth, but the cited automotive radar transfer measurements specifically use 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth rather than requiring the full 30 MHz option | [34][14][15] |
| R&S ZNA supports time domain analysis as a software/measurement option, and time-domain VNA measurement is used for suppression of ghost objects | Time-domain capability is relevant to automotive radar echo/ghost-object measurement | [29][14] |
【推論】As automotive radar shifts toward 76 GHz to 81 GHz and multi-GHz bandwidths, the VNA requirement moves from lower-frequency coverage toward a 110 GHz-class mmWave VNA system plus GHz-span amplitude, group-delay, and time-domain measurement capability [40][49][17][45][14].

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

| Automotive radar change | VNA measurement capability affected | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| RF bands include 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz automotive radar frontends | VNA frequency coverage must extend from microwave into mmWave; 76 GHz to 81 GHz is above a 67 GHz base VNA’s 10 MHz to 67 GHz range and within a 10 MHz to 110 GHz VNA system range | [40][8][17] |
| R&S AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD frontends operate at 76.0 GHz to 81.0 GHz with 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 5 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth | VNA characterization must handle automotive radar frontends with multi-GHz operating bandwidth, not only narrowband S-parameter checks | [49] |
| RF transfer characteristics for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D are measured from RX waveguide input to TX waveguide output connector with a VNA setup using 2.5 MHz frequency step size and 1 kHz measurement bandwidth | VNA measurement setup must support fine frequency stepping and controlled IF/measurement bandwidth for radar frontend transfer characterization | [45] |
| Amplitude flatness is specified as < ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D configurations | VNA capability must support amplitude-flatness measurement across GHz-wide radar bandwidths | [45] |
| Group delay flatness is specified as < ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±1 ns in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±1 ns in 4 GHz bandwidth for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D configurations | VNA capability must support group-delay flatness measurement across GHz-wide radar bandwidths | [45] |
| Suppression of ghost objects is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain, using 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m distance to wanted artificial object, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz | VNA capability must include time-domain analysis and sufficiently fine frequency resolution/span settings for ghost-object evaluation | [14] |
| AREG800A IF transfer measurements use VNA conditions of 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz | VNA capability must cover multi-GHz IF transfer spans with controlled source power and measurement bandwidth | [15] |
| R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option | A VNA used for these measurements has configurable measurement bandwidth, but the cited automotive radar transfer measurements specifically use 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth rather than requiring the full 30 MHz option | [34][14][15] |
| R&S ZNA supports time domain analysis as a software/measurement option, and time-domain VNA measurement is used for suppression of ghost objects | Time-domain capability is relevant to automotive radar echo/ghost-object measurement | [29][14] |
【推論】As automotive radar shifts toward 76 GHz to 81 GHz and multi-GHz bandwidths, the VNA requirement moves from lower-frequency coverage toward a 110 GHz-class mmWave VNA system plus GHz-span amplitude, group-delay, and time-domain measurement capability [40][49][17][45][14].
